items.claim: cBrain announced a strategic partnership with the Danish trade union Djoef to develop integrated digital platforms for unions, describing it as extending its F2 platform into the CRM market with delivery in phases.
items.source: cBrain A/S company announcement, signed by Per Tejs Knudsen, CEO

items.claim: cBrain said it was raising its expected 2026 EBT margin range to 22-26% from 20-25%, citing "solid business development in Q3", while confirming its 10-15% revenue growth expectation for 2026.
items.source: cBrain A/S company announcement, signed by Per Tejs Knudsen, CEO; inquiries directed to Lars Moller Christiansen, CFO & Head of IR

items.claim: Investing.com reported the Djoef partnership and the raised 2026 EBT margin guidance, with an editor's note stating the article was generated with AI support and reviewed by an editor.
items.source: Investing.com, referring to cBrain CEO Per Tejs Knudsen; no direct quotes carried

items.claim: cBrain meddelte, at selskabet har indgaaet et strategisk partnerskab med fagforeningen Djoef om at udvikle en samlet digital platform til fagforeninger, og at selskabet samtidig opjusterer sin forventede resultatmargin foer skat for 2026, mens vaekstforventningen fastholdes.
items.source: cBrain A/S' selskabsmeddelelse, underskrevet af adm. direktoer Per Tejs Knudsen (CFO og IR-ansvarlig Lars Moeller Christiansen anfoert som kontakt)

items.claim: cBrain oplyser at selskabet har etableret cBrain Inc., et helejet amerikansk datterselskab, for at understoette fortsat markedsekspansion.
items.source: cBrain A/S, selskabsmeddelelse nr. 05/2026 (ingen navngivet talsperson citeret; CEO Per Tejs Knudsen staar som afsender)

items.claim: cBrain siger at SAM.gov-registreringen goer det muligt for cBrain Inc. at deltage direkte i amerikanske foederale indkoebsprocesser.
cBrain oplyser at meddelelsen ikke aendrer selskabets tidligere kommunikerede finansielle forventninger for 2026.
